Inspect impl/src/atlas-index.mjs and impl/test/phase13-atlas-index.test.mjs. Write reviews/dogfood/codex-atlas-index-review.md with exact headings "## Verdict", "## Contract matrix", "## Remaining major findings", and "## Required next actions". Try to falsify content-addressed epoch and artifact integrity, explicit epoch selection, base-plus-overlay confinement and non-mutation, staleness truth, lexical/symbol/reference/call honesty, SCIP interchange claims, token bounds/cursor progress, cancellation, reverify, tamper handling, and the claim AT9-AT16 is green. Keep the review under 1800 words and do not accept green tests as sufficient evidence.
Use at most 8 repository-read/tool calls. Once enough evidence is available, stop exploring and write the review.
brief.definitionOfDone: The four exact headings exist and the review explicitly evaluates AT9-AT16
